description: This file defines a report for manufacturing work order stock status in an ERP system, including functions to retrieve work orders, generate report data, and define report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_item_list
methods.description: Generates list of items with stock and buildability info for each work order.

methods.name: get_work_orders
methods.description: Retrieves active work orders that are not completed.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure of the report columns.
